title: run.json
description: run_nd_scenarios / run_kwse_scenarios output record: one hydraulic simulation of one Model at one scenario point. One manifest per Run object — a job call that solves N scenarios writes N of these, never one shared file for the batch (job-execution-level info belongs in job logs / the job's Response, not a manifest). Written LAST to results/reach=<reach_id>/<model identity_hash>/<run identity_hash>/<scenario folder>/run.json. See guide.md's Identity/Realization/Provenance pattern and conventions.md for the shared envelope. All hashes are first-N-hex of SHA-256 (hash_algo): identity hashes 8-hex, file checksums 16-hex.

created_at.description: Run completion time (UTC). run.json is written last, after depth.tif/stl.geojson — see triggers-and-propagation.md's run-preemption policy.

reach_id.description: Primary key for the reach in the reach db. Matches the Model's reach_id.

model_id.description: The exact Model realization (identity_hash+domain_code) this run executed against. Recorded here because the results/ path groups by the Model's identity_hash alone, dropping domain_code — this field is how a run.json 'records the domain used' (see guide.md Storage Layout).

identity_hash.description: Hash of the identity object. Stable across scenario points; results group under it (see guide.md).

scenario_code.description: Run's realization: bc_type + bc_value + 'Q' + q, concatenated (not hashed) — e.g. 'ND1.0e5Q200', 'KWSE200.2Q200'. Precision rules: Q always integer; ND slope and KWSE stage each 0 or 1 decimal digit (see guide.md's Scenario section).

id.description: <identity_hash>_<scenario_code>. Note the underscore separator (Model's id uses '+') — matches the run_id examples in guide.md.

identity.description: The inputs that define Run identity; hashed to identity_hash. Answers 'what solver, what methodology' — same role as Model's identity, one level up the stack.

solver.description: Hydraulic engine name + version, e.g. 'lisflood@8.1' or 'sfincs@2.1.1'. Fixed by which job/container ran (each solver is its own job image — see run_kwse_scenarios_job_contract.md Dependencies), not a caller-supplied choice; still recorded here because it's output-determining.

scenario.description: Run's realization — which point in hydraulic condition-space. Concatenates into scenario_code the way Model's domain{} concatenates into domain_code. Not an entity with its own identity/realization split (see guide.md). bc_value here is the nominal/target value used to build the address — see properties.achieved_bc_value for what the solve actually produced.

q.description: Discharge. Always integer, per scenario_code precision rules.

bc_type.description: ND = normal-depth boundary condition. KWSE = known water-surface elevation boundary condition.

bc_value.description: Nominal normal-depth slope when bc_type is ND; nominal downstream stage (WSEL) when bc_type is KWSE. 0 or 1 decimal digit, per scenario_code precision rules.

inputs.description: The run_nd_scenarios / run_kwse_scenarios call arguments for this one scenario, recorded verbatim. This is Run's provenance — not part of identity_hash or scenario_code. See conventions.md.

model_id.description: Same as top-level model_id; recorded here too since inputs are the verbatim call args.

results_base_path.description: Path where run artifacts will be written.

bc_value.description: Caller-supplied nominal stage for KWSE runs (from plan_scenarios). Null for ND runs — the normal-depth slope is derived from the reach's own model.json (properties.slope), not caller-supplied; the derived value still ends up in scenario.bc_value.

ds_model_id.description: model_id of the reach immediately downstream — KWSE runs only. Required in practice for reaches with a normal downstream reach; null for terminal/lake/coastal reaches, which use a different downstream boundary condition (DR-005, DR-006, DR-008).

hotstart.description: Reference to a prior Run's depth.tif used to warm-start this run's solver — typically a nearby scenario point on the same Model. reach_id/run_identity omitted implies same reach and same run_identity as this run.

downstream_scenario.description: Resolved S3 URI of the downstream reach's Run scenario-point directory (contains stl.geojson + depth.tif), used to build this run's boundary condition — sample the stage onto the STL per DR-031. KWSE runs only. Unlike hotstart, this is a full resolved path rather than scenarioRef coordinates — it crosses reach/model boundaries, so there's no 'same reach/model' default to omit fields against.

max_simulation_length_hours.description: Maximum model-time (sim clock) before forced termination.

max_simulation_wall_time_minutes.description: Maximum wall-clock time before forced termination.

save_velocity.description: Whether to generate and save a velocity raster asset alongside depth.

properties.description: Computed/diagnostic values; informational, not part of identity.

achieved_bc_value.description: The actual boundary value the solve produced, vs. scenario.bc_value's nominal/target value — 'true to nominal' mapping.

volume_convergence.description: Volume convergence metric at termination (see Decision Register DR-022, DR-028).

assets.description: This run's own outputs, keyed by role. These become the next Run's provenance inputs (hotstart/downstream_scenario above) when referenced.

depth.description: Depth raster, COG, EPSG:5070. Also usable as a hotstart seed for another run.

velocity.description: Velocity raster. Present only if inputs.save_velocity was true.

stl.description: This run's own Stage Transfer Line, generated per DR-026. Absent where there's no upstream reach to hand it to.

warnings.description: Non-fatal check results; the run still completes and writes run.json. Non-convergence and hydraulic QC failures (water on an invalid boundary cell, etc.) are hard errors, not warnings — see the job contracts' Errors sections.

hash8.description: First 8 hex of SHA-256 (32-bit). Identity hashes; scoped under reach_id.

checksum16.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 (64-bit). File-integrity checksums.

href.description: Path to the file, e.g. depth.tif, or a full s3:// URI.

source_url.description: External provenance URL, if applicable. Null for purely computed assets.

derived.description: True for outputs regenerable from sources; subject to S3 lifecycle deletion.

scenarioRef.description: A same-model reference to another Run's assets by coordinates, not a resolved path — used for hotstart, where 'same reach, same run_identity unless stated otherwise' is a meaningful default to omit fields against. Cross-model references (e.g. downstream_scenario) use a resolved string path instead, since there's no such default across reach/model boundaries.

reach_id.description: Omitted/null implies the same reach as this run — true for every current use of this $def (hotstart).

run_identity.description: Omitted/null implies the same run_identity as this run.

scenario_point.description: The scenario folder token being referenced, e.g. 'z=283/q=200' or 'nd=1.2e5/q=200'.
